_note: Mirror of offramp/agents/pr_writer.py, so the report says what the PR says. tests/unit/test_web_tables.py keeps them equal.

cause.search_miss: the model's edit to {files} quotes lines matching no single place there, so none applied
cause.deletes_tests: the model's edit deleted {tests}, and Offramp never ships a patch that deletes a test
cause.locked_file: the model tried to edit {files}, which ships exactly as Offramp's code wrote it
cause.not_editable: the model's edit to {files} is not allowed for this site
cause.checks_failed: with the model's test edits applied, this repo's checks still failed
cause.backstop: with the model's test edits applied, code that ships changed ({files}), and only Offramp's code may write it
cause.probe_mismatch: with the model's test edits applied, the call does not send the request that passed the evaluation
cause.merge_conflict: its patch passes this repo's checks on its own, but it conflicts with another migrated site's patch in {files}
cause.not_together: its patch passes this repo's checks on its own, but not merged with the other migrated sites' patches
cause.merged_drift: its patch passes this repo's checks on its own, but on the merged tree its code or its evaluated request changed
cause.repo_red: this repo's own checks fail before any migration patch, so no patch could be checked

alone.checks_failed: with Offramp's changes alone, this repo's checks fail
alone.backstop: with Offramp's changes alone, a check run changed code that ships ({files})
alone.probe_mismatch: Offramp's own rewrite does not send the request that passed the evaluation

ended.budget_stop: The run's model budget ran out {tries} at this site's patch
ended.no_edit_block: The model's last reply had no complete edit, so nothing was applied
ended.no_change: The model's last repair repeated an edit it had already tried

missed.reference_margin: , more than 0.3 below the references' judge mean
